simple.meaning: נְחֹשֶׁת (nᵉchôsheth) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “copper , hence, something made of that metal, i.e. coin , a fetter ; figuratively, base (as compared with gold or silver).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 140 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 8 more, beginning at Genesis 4:22. Its contexts include birth, family, offering.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נְחֹשֶׁת (H5178).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: נְחֹשֶׁת (nᵉchôsheth) / H5178 is traced through Genesis 4:22, Exodus 25:3, Exodus 26:11, Exodus 26:37 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H5178. nechosheth I. נְח֫שֶׁת 137 noun masculine 1Kin 7:45 (compare Albr ZAW xvi (1896), 108 ; feminine1 Chronicles 18:8) copper, bronze (Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew; Phoenician נחשת ; Palmyrene נחשא Lzb 322 ; Syriac , נְחָשָׁא ᵑ7 , Arabic , Ethiopic (so also Old Ethiopic DHM Epigr.Denkm.aus Abess.(1894),52 ); WMM As.u.Eur.127 cites Egyptian teµ(µ)ost , copper (= * tenµost ), as loan-word from נְחשֶׁת + feminine article); — ׳נ absolute Gen 4:22 +; construct Exod 38:29 ; suffix נְחֻשְׁתִּי Lam 3:7 , נְחֻשְׁתֵךְ Ezek 16:36 , נְחֻשְׁתָּהּ 24:11 , נְחֻשְׁתָּם 2Kin 25:13 2 t.; dual נְחֻשְׁתַּ֫יִם Judg 16:21 6 t.; — 1 copper , as ore Deut 8:9 , compare Zech 6:8 ; worked by artificer Gen 4:22 (J) 1Kin 7:14 (twice in verse); 2Chr 24:12 ; material — doubtless hardened with alloy, probably tin, making bronze , compare Now Archaeology i. 243 Benz Archaeology 214 — of armour 1Sam 17:5-6 , 1Kin 14:27 , utensils 2Kin 25:14 = Jer 52:18 ; Lev 6:21 ; Num 17:4 + very often, altar 2Kin 16:14-15 , Exod 38:30 ; 39:39 , etc., and other objects Num 21:9 (twice in verse) (JE), 2Kin 18:4 ; 1Kin 4:13 ; 7:15 ff. +, especially in description of tabernacle and temple; cast 7:14 ; polished מְמֹרָט 7:45 , מָרוּק 2Chr 4:16 (compare Lev 6:21 ); and shining מֻצְהָב Ezra 8:27 . On ׳נ קָלָל Ezek 1:7 ; Dan 10:6 see קלל ; ׳נ as spoil of war 2Sam 8:8 ; 2Kin 25:13 = Jer 52:17 , 20 etc. 2 fetters of copper or bronze , usually dual Judg 16:21 ; 2Sam 3:34 ; 2Kin 25:7 = Jer 39:7 ; 52:11 ; 2Chr 36:6 , also 33:11 ; singular only Lam 3:7 (figurative of oppression). 3 as less in value than gold but more than wood Isa 60:17 (twice in verse); figurative of worthless people Jer 6:28 (+ בַּרְזֶל ), id. (as dross of silver) Ezek 22:18 (+ עוֺפֶרֶת בַּרְזֶל, בְּדִיל, ). — On 16:36 see IV. נחשׁ . 4 figurative of pitiless sky Deut 28:23 . II. [ נְח֫שֶׁת ] noun [feminine] suffix נְחֻשְׁתֵּךְ Ezek 16:36 where context (|| עֶרְוָה ) favours meaning lust, harlotry , or specific sens. obscoen. (Co [citing Ki Ra] Berthol, see also Da); text perhaps corrupt (compare Nö ZMG xl (1886). 730 ); Sm proposes תַּזְנוּתַיִךְ , so apparently Toy Hpt ; Or בָּשְׁתֵּךְ .
